overview: CONNECT is a professional recruitment platform helping fresh graduates and unemployed youth find internships, jobs, and walk-in interview opportunities. The website features a clean blue and white design with service highlights, interview listings, and a candidate registration form.
features: Hero section with tagline and call-to-action buttons
Services showcase: internships with/without stipend, job opportunities
Walk-in interview listings with date, time, location, and job role
About Us page with mission and vision
